newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB 13-wk liquidity bill yield hits 12.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB 13-wk liquidity bill yield hits 12.4 pct.

text.p: Gross yield at the Czech central bank's (CNB) auction of a five billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills was the maximum allowed 12.4 percent, the CNB said in a statement on Friday.
Net yield in the auction was 9.3 percent, the CNB said.
The CNB added that the auction was heavily under-subscribed, with bids totalling only 1.065 billion crowns.
Comparative results were not immediately available, but the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR) for three-month money was 12.83 percent on Thursday.
